subject: english
question: What should come in the place of blank number** ****1?**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Overwhelming**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the air as "**thick**" with the smell of paper and dust. When a sensation is described as thick or dense, it often suggests it is **overwhelming** (अभिभूत कर देने वाला).
 
• The phrase "at once soothing and **overwhelming**" establishes a sensory paradox. It means the scent is comforting (soothing) but also so intense and powerful (overwhelming) that it completely occupies the narrator's senses.
 
• While "Invigorating" (Option 3) means energizing, it doesn't align as well with the description of a "thick" and "earthy" atmosphere as the concept of intensity does.
 
• "**Refreshing**" (Option 1) usually describes light, clean scents, which contrasts with the "dusty" and "earthy" description.
 
• "**Disconcerting**" (Option 4) implies a negative or upsetting feeling, which contradicts the bookstore being called a "refuge."

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

Complete Passage Segment: *The used bookstore was not merely a location where one might purchase books; it was a refuge. The air was thick with the earthy, rich smell of paper and dust, an odd fragrance which was at once soothing and (1) **overwhelming__**. I would spend hours there, running my fingers over the spines of ancient, forgotten books that stood on the shelves. Each novel was another world to discover, and I finally removed a leather-bound book with an odd, yellowed title. Its pages were dry and (2)__________. to the touch, as if one careless turn would make them disintegrate. As I picked up to read the opening lines, the words didn't merely speak a tale-they whisked me off to a whole different world, a place of magical creatures, gallant heroes, and secret spells. The vocabulary was old-fashioned, but impossibly (3)_________, describing gaudy pictures in my head that were more real than the creaky aisles surrounding me. I was amazed by the imagination of the writer, a well that was presumably truly (4)_________. I felt a rush of awe, an appreciation that these tales, as ancient as they were, remained supremely (5) _________ and capable of igniting the imagination of a new generation.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Fragrance (सुगंध):** A pleasant, sweet smell. The author uses this word to show that the narrator finds beauty even in the old, dusty air of the shop.
 
• **Tone and Context:** In competitive exam "Cloze Tests," the adjectives often work in pairs. "Soothing" and "Overwhelming" describe the duality of a deep, nostalgic experience.
 
• **Refuge:** A condition of being safe or sheltered from pursuit, danger, or trouble.
